sentences.text: Dirt -LRB- styled d!rt for logos -RRB- is an American television serial broadcast on the FX network .	FX	FX (TV channel)	American	United States	television	television series	serial	Serial (radio and television)	FX network	FX (TV channel)

It premiered on January 2 , 2007 and starred Courteney Cox as Lucy Spiller , the editor-in-chief of the first-of-its-kind `` glossy tabloid '' magazine DirtNow , which was previously two separate publications : dirt -LRB- a tabloid -RRB- and Now -LRB- a glossy magazine with a more respectable reputation -RRB- .	Courteney Cox	Courteney Cox	tabloid	Supermarket tabloid
A 13-episode second and final season was announced on May 8 , 2007 .
Only seven episodes were produced prior to the 2007 WGA strike shut down production .	2007 WGA strike	2007 Writers Guild of America strike
The shortened second season began airing on March 2 , 2008 .
The show was created by Matthew Carnahan and produced by Coquette Productions and ABC Studios .	Matthew Carnahan	Matthew Carnahan	ABC Studios	ABC Studios
On June 8 , 2008 , FX canceled the series after two seasons .	FX	FX (TV channel)
